title: Pink Dorm Halloween Decor
intro: Most dorms ban real candles and nails in the wall, which kills half of what passes for Halloween decor online. This list works inside those rules. Flameless tea lights and star fairy lights do the glow, stick-on 3D bats climb the wall without a single hole, ghost pillow covers and a ghost and bat throw dress the bed, and ghost glass mugs make hot chocolate night look planned. Everything packs flat in November, and the fairy lights stay up until finals, because of course they do.
